title: Pre-release cleanup: cargo fmt, version string, help text accuracy
description:
Three cleanup items from the v1 release review:

1. Run cargo fmt (drift in ~45 files)
2. Fix version mismatch: Cargo.toml says 0.2.1, MCP server info says v0.1.0
3. Fix sutra_help conventions topic: describes FCA as detecting 'naming patterns' and building a 'concept lattice for naming'. FCA actually extracts attribute implications (e.g. 'pub functions tend to have docs'). Help text should describe what FCA actually detects.

acceptance_criteria.text: Version string consistent between Cargo.toml and MCP server info
sutra_help conventions topic accurately describes FCA behavior
